opportunities.name: Booking.com flight search and select fastest direct flight
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com flights for a given trip type, route(s), date(s) and passenger count, filter to direct flights, sort by fastest, then select a flight and ticket type.
steps: Open Booking.com and click the Flights tab
Choose trip type (One way / Round trip / Multi-city) and tick 'Direct flights only' if needed
Set origin airport(s), removing the default origin
Set destination airport(s); for multi-city, fill each leg
Pick departure date(s) in the calendar
Set number of adults if more than 1
Click Search
Filter Stops to Direct only and, if needed, departure time windows
Sort by Fastest
Click See flight on the top result, then Select
Choose Standard or Flexible ticket and click Next

instances.values: One way, direct only, BLR Bangalore -> GOI Goa, Wed 29 Mar, 2 adults, departs 18:00-23:59, fastest, SpiceJet $428.38, Flexible ticket
Multi-city: New York -> Tokyo Thu 1 Jun, Tokyo -> Delhi Mon 5 Jun, 1 adult, Direct only, fastest, Japan Airlines $1,038.50, Flexible ticket

opportunities.name: Expedia rental car search with filters
opportunities.description: Search Expedia rental cars for a given pickup location, dates and times, then apply car type / capacity / company filters.
steps: Open Expedia and click the Cars tab
Click Pick-up and type the location, pick the suggestion
Set drop-off location if it differs from pick-up
Open the date picker, pick the pick-up and drop-off dates, click Done
Set pick-up and drop-off times if needed
Click Search
Apply sidebar filters (capacity, car type, rental company) and the sort order

instances.values: JFK pick-up and drop-off, Apr 3-Apr 6, 9:00 am-6:00 pm, filters 2-5 passengers + Luxury, sort opened
San Francisco, same drop-off, Apr 8-Apr 9, 10:30 am, filters Avis + Economy

opportunities.name: Carnival cruise search with filters
opportunities.description: Search Carnival cruises by destination, departure port and date, then narrow results with filters such as number of guests.
steps: Open Carnival home page
Click Sail To and pick a destination
Optionally click Sail From and pick a port
Optionally click Dates and pick a month
Click Search Cruises
On results, open Number of Guests and change the guest count
Review prices

instances.values: Panama Canal from San Francisco, Oct 2024
Caribbean, any port and date, guests set to 3 then 4

opportunities.name: MTA planned service changes lookup
opportunities.description: Look up planned service changes on MTA for a given route and date.
steps: Open MTA site and click Planned Work (or Menu > Planned Service Changes)
Click Search Routes and type the route
Select the route from the dropdown
Optionally open Select Date and pick a date
Review results

opportunities.name: SpotHero airport parking search
opportunities.description: Search SpotHero for airport parking at a given airport, then set dates and sort the results.
steps: Open SpotHero home page and click the Airport tab
Click the search box and pick the airport from the list
On results, set parking start and end dates
Change sort order if needed
